svg.metadata: PUBLIC REVIEW NOT FINAL. Original owner PNG unchanged SHA256 79867ef2cea0777a277df45a2754ea012ff552d466963f8cb831e5940a5cafb7. No substitute symbol or new monogram. 130x32mm band, two provisional folds at 40/90mm. Crop and ruler are guides, not a physical proof.
